task.ques: Search for a set of non-stick, oven-safe cookware on Amazon. The set should include at least 10 pieces and be priced under $150.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Blue Diamond 10 Piece Ceramic Nonstick Cookware Pots & Pans Set, Blue — $109.99 on Amazon, verified October 27, 2026.

It meets the requirements: 10 pieces, a ceramic non-stick surface, and cookware oven-safe to 600°F (glass lids to 425°F). The 10 pieces comprise five pots/pans, three lids, and two nylon utensils. The displayed item price is below $150, before shipping, import charges, and tax.

Source: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07CZH2GY9
Evidence: final.png shows the Amazon listing, product name, oven rating, $109.99 price, and selected 10-piece size.
